title: The Songbook of Maple Hollow
author: Jonah Delacroix
blurb: Vesper Underhill, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
